101.Description:
Its crazed whisperings permeate our senses, tormenting our minds. Before I'm consumed by madness, I swear I will kill it!
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

102.Description:
An unspeakably horrific monstrosity flailed its tentacles around, dragging our companions into the dark abyss. Charging at it, this time, we will make it pay!
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

103.Description:
Deep in the dead of night, writhing tentacles reached out of the thick fog, coming for us. We grasped our swords, ready for the oncoming battle.
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

201.Description:
That indescribable creature has returned to haunt my dreams once more. Its enormous body, big enough to blot out the whole sky leaves me standing in darkness. The ground trembles and a great horror draws closer, but I shall no longer fear it.
 ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

202.Description:
The door of chaos opens wide once more, crazed appendages pour forth from the darkness. The time for hunting down the darkness is upon us again.
 ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

203.Description:
The abyss surrounds us again. Having traded blows with it before, I know its weakness. This time, it won't escape.
 ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

301.Description:
Deadly dangers from another dimension encroach upon the realm. The ground shakes and the world trembles.
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

302.Description:
The door to a distant land is open. A supreme overlord approaches.
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

303.Description:
Pierce the shadowy mist where evil spirits lurk and defeat the abyssal beast and let supreme glory forever accompany the divine.
                  —Vault of Time Expedition Log

401.Description:
We no longer fear the unknown, we are no longer trapped by the mist. We will fight, we will triumph!
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

402.Description:
Why do we fight? Despair comes from inside ourselves. The real demon is inside us all, fighting to get out.
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

403.Description:
Fear roots us to the ground, like thick vines entangling our feet. The only remedy to such an affliction is courage!
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

501.Description: Fire broke free from its cage, and the cursecrow flew across the rice fields. Fear was no longer a shadow at the warrior's back, but a flame showing the way forward. — Vault of Time Expedition Log

502.Description: Scorched winds stirred the charred rice husks as a raven's shadow dimmed the sky. The warrior took one more step, blade in hand, as fear cried out for the last time. — Vault of Time Expedition Log

503.Description: Shadows of the rice field swayed along the furrows, and a black feather was still warm to the touch. Before one can escape fear, one must first learn its shape. — Vault of Time Expedition Log

601.Description:
Our captain is dead, but there is no time to mourn. We will not stop fighting until this veil of darkness has been destroyed.
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

602.Description:
Days of battle have broken my sword, but they have not broken my will. Without my weapon, my body shall become a fortress. I will defend my homeland to the bitter end.
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

603.Description:
"If you don't want to die, take up arms." I took the sword from the soldier and joined the expedition. When disaster strikes, I'll have nothing but my sword.
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

701.Description:
The worms finally retreat, leaving us completely exhausted. Newcomers, heed my last warning: Watch out for the menace from underground.
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

702.Description:
The nest breaks out of the ground, and worms trample over the human territories. The Queen's warriors are craving fresh food.
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

703.Description:
After the sudden earthquake, strange sounds are coming from beneath the broken tiles. Who is watching us from underground?
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

801.Description:
The reason we paid the painful price, is to send a message to the worms underground––that they shall not invade our homeland!
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

802.Description:
Looking into its blood-shot eyes, we feel the burning pain as well. But we must keep our eyes open, hold on to our swords, and fight the enemy to our death.
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

803.Description:
Worms dwell underground while humans live under the sun. Both should never have to cross paths, but are now threatened by the same Elemental Strife.
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

901.Description:
The warriors will conquer the most treacherous waves. Even in the abyss of death, they will send the departed souls on their way home, guided by the Divine Light.
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

902.Description:
We cannot ignore the sacrifices of the warriors. Without victory, there is no salvation.
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

903.Description:
They do not belong here; yet they are now the prisoners of the evil spirits. Will this be an eternal torture for them?
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

1001.Description:
Turbulent waves echo the tunes of resolve; violent storms sound the beats of the fearless. Forge the glory of warriors, with courage and conviction.
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

1002.Description:
Its roar warns of the headlong plunge off the cliff. Awaiting us is a bottomless abyss and eternal fear.
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

1003.Description:
Hold your breath. This may be the last one you draw before facing it.
                  ——Vault of Time Expedition Log

When the imperial seal stamps down, even the stars fall silent. And yet still, the ruler's will echoes across the land. This seal bears the mandate of the gods and the power of the Empire, its stamp a symbol of dominion. Where its radiance shines, the realm becomes eternal.

Morning light shines down as the bronze coffer hums softly. Forged in soaring flames, the Oathkey hovers silently above the lock plate, guarding treasures yet unseen.
Your Guild won {0} time(s) in Great Pursuit, and this First Mark is witness to your oath of unity.

3002.Description:
Silver light swirls as banners flutter aloft. The bitter battles of the past have sunk to the bottom of the coffer, but the glory atop the crown still shines bright, a testament to the honor of comrades-in-arms.
Your Guild won {0} time(s) in Great Pursuit, and the Sparkling Sacrifice lauds your joint efforts.

Golden rays sweep wide as the coffer flies open. Myriad treasures glimmer as the silhouettes of heroes line up beneath the light, gathering into an eternal crown of reigning glory.
